oneOf.description:
Set a parameter of a device, by the parameter's id, in the unit the device
declares. The parameter must be one the device has and the value must be finite;
the engine clamps it to the parameter's range. The built-in synth's parameters:
`waveform` (0 sine, 1 saw, 2 square, 3 triangle), `attack`, `decay` and
`release` (seconds, 0.002 to 30), `sustain` (0 to 1), `gain` (0 to 1, linear).
Undo: set the parameter back to its previous value.

HistoryCommand.description: The commands of this domain, tagged by `type`.

oneOf.description:
Undo the last entry of the history: one command, or every command of one
history group. Does nothing when there is nothing to undo; refused while a
group is open. Undo: `history.redo`.

Open a history group: every edit of the same author until `history.end_group`
becomes one entry, undone at once (a mouse drag). Refused when a group is
already open (groups do not nest). Undo and redo are refused while it is open:
the host ends it when the gesture or the turn ends. Not undoable itself.

Close the open history group. Refused when no group is open, or when another
author opened it. Not undoable itself.

oneOf.description:
Start a note on a track's instrument. `note` is a MIDI note number, 0 to 127
(60 = middle C); `velocity` 1 to 127, 0 acts as a note off. Played live: not
undoable, not saved.

Release a note started with `live.note_on` on the same track. Played live: not
undoable, not saved.

changes no project data.

saved with the project.

MixerCommand.description: The commands of this domain, tagged by `type`.

oneOf.description:

the range or not a number is refused. A fader gesture sent in one history group
is undone in one step. Undo: set the previous volume back.

not a number is refused. A pan gesture sent in one history group is undone in
one step. Undo: set the previous pan back.

Mute or unmute a track. Mute is saved with the project and versioned. Undo: set
the previous state back.

Set the master's volume in dB, from -96 to +6; `null` is silence. A value
outside the range or not a number is refused. Undo: set the previous volume
back.

gain_db.description: Required: `null` is silence, a missing field is an error.

history group. Does nothing when there is nothing to undo; refused while a

oneOf.description:

the range or not a number is refused. A fader gesture sent in one history group
is undone in one step. Undo: set the previous volume back.

not a number is refused. A pan gesture sent in one history group is undone in
one step. Undo: set the previous pan back.

Mute or unmute a track. Mute is saved with the project and versioned. Undo: set
the previous state back.

Set the master's volume in dB, from -96 to +6; `null` is silence. A value
outside the range or not a number is refused. Undo: set the previous volume
back.

gain_db.description: Required: `null` is silence, a missing field is an error.
